item.title: Effective Methods to Execute External Python Files Programmatically
item.description:
“Effective Methods to Execute External Python Files Programmatically”

Here we detail several approaches for making one Python file execute the contents of another, ranked from preferred to least advisable practices.

The Preferred Approach: Treating Files as Modules

The most idiomatic, secure, and performant way to integrate code from another file is by treating it as a standard Python module. This leverages Python’s built-in module loading mechanism, ensuring proper namespace isolation and code reuse, mirroring how standard libraries operate.
